analysis.caption: Extended text — structure and repetition patterns matter.

parsed.executive_summary: Zomato faces a critical trust crisis driven by late deliveries, cold food, and a customer support system that offers token refunds instead of resolutions, pushing even loyal users toward alternatives.

sentiment_trajectory.insight: Sentiment is declining sharply due to repeated delivery failures and a support system that deflects rather than resolves, eroding trust even among previously satisfied users.

contradiction_analysis.what_they_say: I am happy with Zomato orderings
contradiction_analysis.what_they_do: User gives a 5-star rating but in other reviews describes late delivery and cold food, indicating they tolerate poor service out of habit.
User praises a feature that is being removed or restricted, as other reviews complain 'cash on delivery karvate hi nahin Hai', showing the feature is not consistently available.

contradiction_analysis.what_they_say: Swiggy se ach app hai zomato
contradiction_analysis.what_they_do: User claims Zomato is better than Swiggy but in the same breath complains about high charges and late delivery, revealing a forced loyalty with no real alternative.

feature_requests.feature: faster and full refunds for wrong/missing items
reliable and responsive customer support with human agents
restore and guarantee cash on delivery option
accurate delivery time estimates and live tracking
transparent pricing with no hidden charges

emotions.trigger: delivery marked as delivered but order not received, and support offers only a fraction of the refund
missing items in order and support gives only two options: accept a tiny refund or just share feedback
cold food and poor quality despite paying full amount, with no resolution from support

psychographic_segments.how_to_win_them: offer instant, full refunds and a direct line to a human support agent who can resolve issues in one call
ensure delivery times are accurate and food arrives hot; provide a loyalty discount for frequent orders to offset high charges
eliminate hidden packing and handling fees; show a clear, upfront total price before checkout

high_risk_signals.signal: late delivery and cold food on arrival
high_risk_signals.retention_action: implement a 'hot food guarantee' with automatic refund or credit if food arrives cold or late

high_risk_signals.signal: customer support offers token refunds instead of full resolution
high_risk_signals.retention_action: overhaul support policy to provide full refunds for missing/wrong items and empower agents to resolve complaints immediately

high_risk_signals.signal: high and hidden delivery charges making orders unaffordable
high_risk_signals.retention_action: introduce a transparent pricing model and a subscription pass for free delivery to lock in price-sensitive users

strategic_recommendations.action: Overhaul customer support to offer full refunds and live agent chat within the app
strategic_recommendations.why: The current support system is the #1 driver of churn, with users reporting that they get only a fraction of the refund or just a feedback form
strategic_recommendations.expected_outcome: Reduce complaint-related churn by 40% and improve app store rating by 0.5 stars within 3 months

strategic_recommendations.action: Implement a 'Delivery Time Guarantee' with automatic compensation for late orders
strategic_recommendations.why: Users are planning meals based on Zomato's delivery times and getting burned, which destroys trust in the platform
strategic_recommendations.expected_outcome: Increase repeat order rate by 25% among users who previously complained about late delivery

strategic_recommendations.action: Restore and prominently feature cash on delivery as a payment option
strategic_recommendations.why: Multiple users are furious that COD has been removed, and this is a dealbreaker for a significant segment of the user base
strategic_recommendations.expected_outcome: Recover 15% of users who have switched to competitors due to lack of COD, within 2 months

passion_index.reasoning: High density of code-mixed Hinglish, emoji usage, and extreme frustration signals in the raw quotes, indicating strong emotional engagement and informal, high-passion communication.
